title: Bound QQ16 private d_A retention at the B1 cut
body:
## Result

This is a scoped negative result for one proposed QQ16 interface mechanism: retaining the post-`B_1_2` eight-coordinate `d_A = Y_A` observation in the existing owned fields `C0..C7`.

At the exact pinned cut, the private fields return in frame I, while the eight A-port Y outputs have frames `f117, f124, f137, f144, f153, f163, f174, f228`, each with 18 nonzero Z4 terms. An exact scan of all 3,650 registered cover maps finds no one-map normalization to I. In the one-term native-line model, matching the eight private fields to the source frames requires at least 144 rank-one line calls, with 288 associated full-cover map operations. The eight coefficient-one scalar copies cost 32 real scalar primitives. Terminal cleanup adds eight clear primitives; a following retained core can reuse its existing clears.

The current favorable rank-eight output envelope in [Discussion #2074](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2074) leaves at most two further rank-one-equivalent calls above the selected ceiling. The 144-line floor exceeds that planning allowance before charging the record handling, physical address/stream costs, global hosting, or recursive precision. This is scoped to the pinned single-map search and one-term line conversion model; it does not rule out a multi-map route or another state layout. No controller or new κ is claimed.

## Reproduction and evidence

```sh
python3 -I -B research/qq16-private-da-frame-floor-seed81b017/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/qq16-private-da-frame-floor-seed81b017/test_package.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-private-da-frame-floor-seed81b017 --check-only
```

The first two commands pass locally on CPython 3.14.7. Package metadata and source pins pass. This environment has no CPython 3.12 executable, so I could not run the registered Python 3.12 replay locally; no hosted CI result is claimed here.

The package pins base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, selected record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`, and the QQ16 certificate SHA-256 `a5ed85fac5ebf3c091482a113ab0d351eb5a7892fe2841a35e16017ec1ff49f7`. The positive controls check the identity map and one-term cancellation; negative controls reject a wrong stage, wrong port, and mutated source certificate.

## Relation to prior work

Merged PR #1969 supplies the retained QQ16 words and native wrapper conventions. PR #2174 (`f79470a7931f3943360c10d15b428e0e4e479c22`) supplies the conditional two-query decoder and identifies realization of `d_A` at the B1 cut as open. This contribution tests one concrete private-bank relay mechanism. It is separate from the pre-F0 ordinary-to-selected `B2 X_U` observation claimed in Discussion #2074.

Claim and handoff: [Discussion #2192](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2192). Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used; no independent human review is claimed.
